MERIDIAN REVCYCLE — BUSINESS ASSOCIATE AGREEMENT AND DATA ADDENDUM
Version 6.0 — Effective 2025-04-01
Retrieved 2026-02-03T09:26:22Z

1. DEFINITIONS
Terms used but not defined have the meaning given in 45 CFR Parts 160 and 164.

2. PERMITTED USES
2.1 Business Associate may use Protected Health Information (PHI) only as required to perform the Services.
2.2 Business Associate may de-identify PHI in accordance with 45 CFR 164.514(b) and use the resulting
    de-identified data for product improvement, including training of machine learning models.
2.3 Covered Entity may opt out of Section 2.2 by written notice.

3. SUBCONTRACTORS
3.1 Business Associate obtains written assurances from subcontractors that create, receive, maintain, or
    transmit PHI on its behalf, consistent with 45 CFR 164.308(b)(2).

4. MACHINE LEARNING FEATURES
4.1 Coding Assist output constitutes a suggestion only. Covered Entity retains sole responsibility for the
    codes submitted on a claim.
4.2 Business Associate maintains an audit trail of Coding Assist suggestions and user decisions for seven
    years.
4.3 Business Associate performs internal validation of model accuracy quarterly. Validation covers overall
    accuracy and specialty-level accuracy. Validation does not currently include subgroup analysis by
    patient demographic characteristics.
4.4 Business Associate notifies Covered Entity of material changes to Coding Assist model behavior in the
    release notes accompanying each version.

5. SECURITY INCIDENTS
5.1 Business Associate reports Breaches of Unsecured PHI within 48 hours of discovery.

6. TERM AND TERMINATION
6.1 On termination, Business Associate returns or destroys all PHI within 60 days.
